about_intro: {brand} was created with a single goal: to simplify and digitalize the world of cars. We understand that vehicle ownership involves more than just buying and selling — it also includes maintenance, upgrades and finding reliable services. That's why we are building a platform that brings it all together in one place.

about_vision_p: We want to become the leading digital automotive ecosystem that brings drivers, sellers and service providers together in one place, creating value for the entire community.
